name: Pareto FalconX Credit Vault
oneLiner: AA_FalconXUSDC is a Pareto FalconX Credit Vault token: USDC exposure to FalconX institutional credit lines curated by M11 Credit.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-derived 2026-07-30 at Ethereum block 25648410. Sole tracked deployment AA_FalconXUSDC 0xc26a6fa2c37b38e549a4a1807543801db684f99c is non-proxy (EIP-1967 implementation slot zero). minter() returns IdleCDO 0x433d5b175148da32ffe1e1a37a939e1b7e79be4d. Runtime bytecode includes burn(address,uint256) and mint but no transfer blacklist/pause/freeze selectors. Pinned IdleCDOTranche.sol exposes burn(account, amount) gated only by msg.sender == minter, which destroys that account's balance without holder authorization—a live holder-selective seize surface controlled by the minter. The minter is a transparent proxy to IdleCDOEpochVariant 0xdd596250f838af8862d30e9c78a143356894a18d; paused() returned true at the observation block. Parent IdleCDO._withdrawOps currently burns only msg.sender, but the token-level minter privilege remains an unconditional burn-any-holder capability and the CDO is upgradeable. Controlling authority: IdleCDO minter/admin over the tranche token. Failure domain: contract:ethereum:0xc26a6fa2c37b38e549a4a1807543801db684f99c plus upgradeable minter 0x433d5b175148da32ffe1e1a37a939e1b7e79be4d. USDC reserve freezes remain additional upstream exposure via variantOf usdc-circle.

mintAuthority.summary: AA_FalconXUSDC is a direct IdleCDOTranche token whose shares are minted exclusively by IdleCDO 0x433d5b17... against USDC deposits. The IdleCDO mint logic is a transparent proxy controlled by an 86,400-second timelock; the tranche has no independent proxy or privileged mint key. Base USDC supply is inherited from Circle.

controls.label: AA_FalconXUSDC IdleCDOTranche token (deposit-only mint)
controls.capDescription: Tranche shares minted only by the IdleCDO contract (0x433d5b175148da32ffe1e1a37a939e1b7e79be4d) upon USDC deposit; no privileged mint role outside deposit.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, minter() returned IdleCDO 0x433d5b175148da32ffe1e1a37a939e1b7e79be4d. The tranche's EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were all zero, so the tracked token itself has no proxy upgrade path.

controls.label: IdleCDO (TransparentProxy) — controls tranche minting

CDO owner = Idle Finance Safe 8/3 (0xfb3bd022d5dacf95ee28a6b07825d4ff9c5b3814).

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, ProxyAdmin owner() returned this timelock and getMinDelay() returned 86,400 seconds. Current role reads showed the 3/8 Idle Finance Safe as proposer, canceller, and executor, while the original deployer's proposer role was revoked.

controls.label: Inherited USDC (Circle) issuer mint path
controls.evidence: Underlying USDC supply is issuer-minted by Circle; this wrapper holds USDC and inherits that base mint authority.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, AA_FalconXUSDC minter() still returned IdleCDO 0x433d5b175.... The direct tranche had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. IdleCDO's transparent proxy had implementation 0xdd596250..., ProxyAdmin 0x9438904a..., and ProxyAdmin owner timelock 0xda86e15d... with an 86,400-second minimum delay. Economic-cap review completed 2026-07-15: tranche shares are minted only by the IdleCDO against deposited USDC. Changing that deposit-bound mint logic requires the independently enforced 86,400-second upgrade timelock, so the economic cap is raiseable rather than unbounded. No exact product-level prudential supervisor was identified. M-2 evidence binding 2026-08-08: reconciliation continuous is the deposit-bound mint itself - fixed-block simulations (Ethereum 25526837) prove tranche shares are minted only by the IdleCDO against deposited USDC, so supply reconciles against vault collateral by construction; changing that binding requires the sourced 86,400-second timelock.

notices.message: AA_FalconXUSDC is a Pareto credit-vault share, not a par-redeemable Falcon Finance USDf wrapper. Monthly exits depend on the vault credit line and Pareto redemption process.
